sources.title: lostargon/Tiny-Jev-1.7B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 1.7B "System One" decision model: structured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out. Not affiliated with TypeSafe AI. Tiny-Jev is an independent, open-weights model inspired by the System One idea and the Jev decision API published by TypeSafe AI. It is not built, endorsed, or supported by them, shares no code or weights with their models, and "Jev" in the name refers only to the ...

sources.title: Jev AI — Decisions at machine speed
sources.snippet: Jev AI is the first System One Model from TypeSafe AI: type-safe decisions in 70-500 ms, zero hallucinations, calibrated confidence. Founded by a ChatGPT co-inventor. Output tokens free, input from $0.042 per million.

sources.title: Models - TypeSafe AI
sources.snippet: GET /v1/models returns the names your account can send in the model field, with a description and release date for each. It currently lists the aliases. Versioned IDs such as jev-1.13.0 are accepted by the model field whether or not they appear in the list.

sources.title: Jev AI Community: Powered by the Jev Model
sources.snippet: Join the Jev AI community to share and explore developer use cases, prompting workflows, and structured decision-making examples powered by the Jev Model.

sources.title: Jev AI Model (TypeSafe) — Typed System One Decisions
sources.snippet: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One model: it returns a choice, score, or yes/no probability instead of chat. The hosted API is open as of 21 September 2026. $0.042 per 1M input tokens, output free.
